description: This file defines route handlers for metrics-related endpoints in an Express.js web server, including aggregating metric stats and retrieving recent activities.

methods.name: GET /metrics/stats
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch aggregated metric statistics, including total, count, average, and some trend indicators.

methods.name: GET /metrics/activity
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve recent activity logs with pagination support, returning activity data with user info and actions.
